chapter: Chicago, Detroit and Seattle Harmony Kings
title: Hearing Ben Pollack's band at the Rendezvous, with Benny Goodman in short pants
summary: At the Rendezvous he hears Pollack's band with a teenage Goodman, Fud Livingston and Glenn Miller, the first jazz band with real arrangements he had heard since the Wolverines.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Yeah - the last time we worked there - we only worked two weeks - then they had the the offer for the Rendezvous -- well, when we went to the Rendezvous; this is the most high class nightclub in all of Chicago and it had an outside garden; a beautiful, beautiful room inside and a big bandstand way above the floor and, oh, it was lovely. And, uh, I thought -- well, gee, let's go hear the band before we open up -- I was with my friend, the bass player - a guy named von Pfister --- George von Pfister, and we went to hear the band and who do you think it was?
I know who it was--- but go ahead and tell---
Well, I can't think of his name---
Ben Pollack---
Ben Pollack -- and that's the first time I heard Benny Goodman and there he is sitting there in short pants---(laughter)- like--
Was he really wearing short pants--
Yes - like the kids in school -- like when I went to school; I think I'm a couple of years older than he---
You are---- about four years older---
Four years older---
Almost - yeah.
And, I know they got him some long pants later---
Yeah- he probably was 16 or 17 years
old---
Yeah. When I heard that band with Fud Livingston and, uh, ---
What did he play - tenor---?
Tenor and clarinet -- and then they had the great trombone player - they had the great band that was lost in the war---
Oh, Glenn Miller---

Glenn Miller was playing trombone in there. But, what I want to tell you is - that's the first time since I heard the Wolverines to hear a jazz band with arrangements; I mean arrangements - really changes of keys and flying around---
Now, explain how that worked -- (inaudible).
Well, they were leaving and we were coming in---
Oh -- I thought you alternated for awhile--
